decks.notes: This UW Control deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It utilizes planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Narset, Parter of Veils to generate value and answer threats. The deck also includes versatile spells such as Shark Typhoon and Dovin's Veto to adapt to different situations. With a mix of board wipes like Supreme Verdict and spot removal like Fateful Absence, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its win conditions through card advantage and powerful threats like The Wandering Emperor.

Utilizing a combination of graveyard recursion and creature tokens, this deck aims to quickly assemble the Greasefang Parhelion combo to overwhelm opponents with a powerful and difficult-to-remove threat. The deck features a mix of disruption, card selection, and ramp to help facilitate the combo while also providing backup win conditions in the form of Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Esika's Chariot. By effectively managing resources and timing key plays, this deck can create explosive turns and generate an overwhelming board presence to secure victory.

The main concept of this Izzet Control deck is to use a combination of removal, counterspells, and card draw to control the game and protect your threats. By efficiently clearing the board of opponent's creatures, countering their spells, and drawing additional cards, you aim to outvalue and out-tempo your opponent until you can land a powerful win condition like Crackling Drake or Otawara, Soaring City. The deck aims to control the pace of the game and grind out a victory through efficient spellcasting and strategic decision-making.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by countering opponent's spells, wiping the board with Supreme Verdict, and generating card advantage through Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Memory Deluge. It also utilizes Shark Typhoon to create flying threats and March of Otherworldly Light to protect its Planeswalkers. The deck aims to stall the game until it can establish a dominant position with powerful threats like Hall of Storm Giants and The Wandering Emperor, while using lands like Field of Ruin to disrupt opponent's strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly with green devotion creatures like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, along with Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, in order to play powerful threats like Cavalier of Thorns, Old-Growth Troll, and Polukranos Reborn. Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner helps with ramp and card draw, while Karn, the Great Creator provides utility and disruption. Storm the Festival and Oath of Nissa help dig for key pieces, while Lair of the Hydra and Boseiju, Who Endures provide additional threats and protection.

This deck focuses on assembling the combo of Lotus Field with various cards that untap lands or search for specific lands to generate a large amount of mana quickly. By utilizing cards like Hidden Strings, Thespian's Stage, and Vizier of Tumbling Sands, the deck aims to ramp up to powerful spells like Omniscience or Emergent Ultimatum. The inclusion of some control elements like Baral, Chief of Compliance and Lier, Disciple of the Drowned help protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck seeks to set up for explosive turns and overwhelm the opponent with powerful spells and abundance of mana.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with Omnath, Locus of Creation and using Bring to Light to search for key cards. The control elements come in with cards like Chained to the Rocks and Leyline Binding, while also having access to Slaughter Games to disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck also includes a mix of powerful creatures like Hostage Taker and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines for added versatility and threat. The inclusion of a variety of lands and companions adds extra flexibility and consistency to the deck's game plan.

This deck focuses on aggressive play, utilizing efficient removal spells and powerful creatures to apply pressure on the opponent. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push while deploying threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester to quickly close out the game. The inclusion of planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse adds additional versatility and resilience to the deck. Overall, the strategy revolves around fast, impactful plays to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive and fast-paced gameplay, aiming to deal damage quickly to the opponent. It includes cards like Monastery Swiftspear, Goblin Chainwhirler, and Bonecrusher Giant to apply pressure early on. The deck also utilizes burn spells like Lightning Strike and Play with Fire to deal direct damage to the opponent or remove threats on the board. With cards like Torbran, Thane of Red Fell and Soul-Scar Mage increasing the effectiveness of burn spells, this deck is designed to maintain control of the battlefield and win through relentless aggression.

The deck focuses on utilizing Retraction Helix along with Jeskai Ascendancy to create a powerful combo engine. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mox Amber help to generate mana and recur key pieces, while cards like Skrelv, Defector Mite and Rona, Herald of Invasion provide additional value and card advantage. The inclusion of Tormod's Crypt and Portable Hole helps to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while cards like Spell Pierce provide protection for the combo. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and actions.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the powerful land card Lotus Field in combination with cards like Thespian's Stage, Hidden Strings, and Sylvan Scrying to generate large amounts of mana quickly. This allows the player to cast big spells like Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum early in the game. The deck also includes cards like Impulse and Pore Over the Pages to dig through the deck for key combo pieces. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast mana production and powerful spells.

The deck revolves around assembling the combo of Lotus Field with cards like Sylvan Scrying and Thespian's Stage to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It utilizes cards such as Impulse and Pore Over the Pages for card selection and advantage, while also running Hidden Strings and Vizier of Tumbling Sands for untapping Lotus Field. The deck can also tutor for key pieces with cards like Dark Petition and Mastermind's Acquisition, and has powerful finishers such as Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum to close out the game.

The main focus of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly with Llanowar Elves, Elvish Mystic, Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, and Wolfwillow Haven to cast powerful green spells like Cavalier of Thorns, Karn, the Great Creator, and Old-Growth Troll. Using Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Oath of Nissa to help find key pieces and generate card advantage. Storm the Festival is used to dig for more threats and Boseiju, Who Endures can protect key spells from countermagic. Lair of the Hydra provides a mana sink and Polukranos Reborn acts as a versatile threat.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly applying pressure to the opponent with aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant, Kroxa, and Bloodtithe Harvester. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Thoughtseize and removal spells like Fatal Push and Power Word Kill to control the board. With a mix of efficient threats and disruption, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory. The inclusion of cards like Haunted Ridge and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional value and versatility to adapt to different situations.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly develop a board presence with low-cost Spirit creatures and disrupt the opponent's strategy with counterspells and bounce effects. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game by maintaining pressure on the opponent while protecting its own creatures. By utilizing efficient spells like Curious Obsession and Geistlight Snare, the deck can draw cards and remove threats, respectively. The inclusion of cards like Katilda, Dawnhart Martyr and Otawara, Soaring City provide additional value and utility. Overall, this deck focuses on aggressive tempo plays with an Azorius Spirit tribal theme.

This aggressive red deck aims to quickly damage the opponent while punishing them for playing spells, thanks to cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel and Soul-Scar Mage. Kari Zev, Skyship Raider and Monastery Swiftspear provide quick creatures to attack with, while Torbran, Thane of Red Fell boosts the damage output of all red sources. Play with Fire and Lightning Strike offer additional burn spells to finish off the opponent, with land cards like Ramunap Ruins and Den of the Bugbear providing extra utility. Overall, the deck is designed to overwhelm the opponent with fast damage and efficient spells.
